proves.claim: the store's one exported itemPace reads sprint, steady or strict from the frozen bar, and the merged writer lands a submitted sprint item by the landing table's sprint row submitted instead of refusing NOT_VERIFIED.

store.sprint-pace.merged-takes-sprint-ro.why: The merged writer's private pace copy read strict only, so a sprint item was decided as steady and refused before the sprint row was reached.

proves.claim: the verify table snapshot of a sprint item carries pace sprint, so the verify table runs its sprint rows.

store.sprint-pace.verify-snapshot-carrie.why: Without a pace key runTable runs every item as steady and skips the sprint rows.

proves.claim: a steady or strict item gets the same merged decision, refusals and verify snapshot (no pace key) as before, and reading the pace adds no board statement.

store.sprint-pace.steady-unchanged.why: Sprint wiring must change nothing for steady items and add no board call.
